title: Cursor adapter
description: A small ink cursor stretches into the exact width of a title in a sharp yellow publishing index.
useCase: Give editorial links a scoped pointer treatment that identifies the actual actionable text.
interaction: Move across titles and choose a book.
reducedMotion: The native cursor and focus states remain; the auxiliary cursor and trail are disabled.
limitations: The custom pointer enhancement is mouse-only and scoped to this component. Native controls remain usable on touch.
look: Saturated lemon-yellow page with a stacked list of large black sans-serif titles, faint arrow glyphs at right, and a thin ruled footer.
motion: A small black ink bar trails the mouse with exponential smoothing, shedding fading dots; over a title it glides beneath the text and stretches to the title's exact width.
adapt: The cursor is painted on the overlay `canvas` in `paint`: `head` eases toward `target` (the hovered `button[data-book]` span) with `1 - Math.exp(-dt / 65)`, and `trail` dots last 230 ms. Replace `titles` and footer copy; tag other targets with `data-book`.
